svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="seo-agent-flows" name="The SEO agent: data in, drafts out, a person decides"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" background="#ffffff" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;" value="The SEO agent: data in, drafts out, a person decides" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="700" x="20" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sched" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=13;" value="Schedules (UTC)
or Run now / MCP" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="180" x="20" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sync" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=13;" value="Sync flows
Search Console, GA4,
DataForSEO" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="180" x="250" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="data" parent="1" style="shape=cylinder3;boundedLbl=1;size=8;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=12;" value="SEO data
(PostgreSQL)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="150" x="480" y="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rules" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=13;" value="Rules + ML models
scoring, decay, intent,
clusters, related" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="190" x="680" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="recs" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="Recommendations,
reports, alerts" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="170" x="920" y="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="opt" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=13;" value="optimize_article_flow /
new_article_flow
(Claude crews)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="200" x="480" y="190" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="drafts" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="Drafts
ready for review" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="160" x="730" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="gate" parent="1" style="rhombus;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Human
approval" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="130" x="940" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pub" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="publish_flow
publish + submit" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="170" x="920" y="330" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="budget" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;" value="Budgets and kill switches
(Automation & AI)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="200" x="210" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e0" edge="1" parent="1" source="sched" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="sync" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="rules" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="rules" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="recs" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="rules" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="opt" value="worth fixing"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="opt" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="drafts"
